latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the "free-tool-strategy" skill to help users plan, evaluate, or build free tools for marketing purposes (lead generation, SEO, or brand awareness).
- Provides a structured framework for assessing business context, defining goals, and evaluating resources before tool development.
- Includes a detailed overview of common tool types, ideation frameworks, validation criteria, lead capture strategies, and SEO considerations.
- Offers clear guidelines on when to build custom tools, use no-code solutions, or embed existing ones.
- Features an easy-to-use evaluation scorecard to prioritize tool ideas and related skill suggestions for landing page optimization, analytics, and lead nurturing.
